_note: How many indicator LEDs each serial channel lights on the LED board; read by `python -m tmaze.tools.sync_fit --map` to know how many to look for (see tmaze/core/sync/board_layout.py, docs/decisions/0196). Each beam (S0-S5) and lick (L0-L2) sensor lights two LEDs, one per row (named _a = bright row, _b = dim row); each reward valve (SOL..) one. leds_per_channel (e.g. "S0": 1) overrides leds_per_kind for a single channel.
